tagline: Prepare a clear vehicle handover and transport brief.
introduction: A practical companion for understanding Bahn Express's public vehicle transport process and preparing the information a human operator needs.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Bahn Express? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Prepare a transport brief
capabilities.description: Organize the non-sensitive details needed to discuss a vehicle move.

capabilities.title: Create a handover checklist
capabilities.description: Plan evidence and responsibilities for pickup and delivery.

capabilities.title: Explain a transport update
capabilities.description: Separate supplied plans from reported custody events, flag stale or missing evidence, and identify the next human verification.
inputs: redacted update or fictional custody event timeline
outputs: unverified state card, evidence gaps and follow-up questions

starterPrompts: Help me draft a vehicle transport enquiry without including personal identifiers.
Create a pickup and delivery checklist for a vehicle transport, including condition documentation.
Explain this transport update and identify which details I still need from Bahn Express.

sources.title: Bahn Express vehicle transport
sources.summary: Official information about vehicle transport, booking and delivery workflows.
